title: RAMP: Retrieval and Attribute-Marking Enhanced Prompting for Attribute-Controlled Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating gender accuracy in attribute-controlled machine translation using the MT-GenEval dataset. The model is prompted to translate gender-ambiguous source sentences into a target language with explicit gender markers (feminine or masculine). The outputs are evaluated using lexical matching metrics and multilingual sentential classifiers to verify successful gender control and avoid misgendering.
